**1.0 cut DONE — v1.0.0 tagged on main**

DONE (2026-07-25): the 1.0 cut is complete. PR #320 (release: cut v1.0.0) merged feature/v2.0.0 -> main (mergeCommit 9d66221); tag v1.0.0 created + pushed on main. Release issue #319 closed via 'Closes #319'. package.json=1.0.0, README tags=v1.0.0, CHANGELOG has ## v1.0.0.
This is the first stable tag, a CONTROLLED-PILOT release (own repos / Sinergia) — NOT open external adoption yet (see docs/KNOWN-LIMITATIONS.md). Hard gate before external = auto-update-safety (rollback/clobber/lockout, M4).
Governance notes from the cut: main IS protected (5 required checks: issue-link, diff-size, local-checks, memory-gate, decision-gate). Release went through a governance PR, NOT a direct push. size:exception applied via REST (gh pr/issue edit --add-label silently fails on GraphQL projects-classic). status:approved on #319 applied by the HUMAN maintainer (agent never applies it, #124). Approving the ISSUE does not auto-rerun the PR workflow -> had to `gh run rerun <run> --failed` to re-evaluate issue-link. release.yml fires on tag push but per #210 runs after the tag exists so it can't block (harmless for pilot).
Going forward: 1.1 slices branch off MAIN (main is the new baseline; feature/v2.0.0 is now merged/retired, 1 behind main). 1.1 roadmap in [[architecture/remaining-path-1.1]]: M2->M3->M4->M5->M8->M6->M7. Epic #313.
Related: [[architecture/remaining-path-1.1]] [[release/pr-318-merged]] [[architecture/v2-epic-plan]].
